title: DiscoveryResult
description: Normalized output of one discovery pass over a page/screen, matching com.test.automation.sdk.discovery.DiscoveryResult (Structure Cleanup Phase 6). Produced by utility.WebElementDiscoveryAdapter or mobile.crawler.MobileElementDiscoveryAdapter.

sourceLabel.description: URL (web) or screen/context identifier (mobile) this result was discovered from.

tagOrType.description: HTML tag (web) or native class name (mobile), e.g. "input" or "android.widget.Button".

text.description: Visible text, or resolved label text when the element itself has none.

resolved.description: True when at least one candidate is marked UNIQUE.

value.description: The XPath (web) or locator value (mobile) for this candidate.

marker.description: Uniqueness/safety marker -- only UNIQUE candidates are safe to use in a Page Object.

matchCount.description: Number of elements this candidate matched, when known; -1 when not tracked.
